# Owned boolean array varargs fixture

A single method-owned Object formal binds the original one-dimensional array
of a public static variable-arity method with a boolean result. Opaque provider
behavior checks identity, null, empty, cyclic and covariant arrays, writes before
failure and exact callback exceptions. Four immutable caller routes run 96 fresh
JVM cases twice. Both source and SDK-provider profiles compile every recovered
unit with original metadata. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving signature
controls distinguish behavior and scope. Only owned fixture code executes.
Use JDK 25; originals use release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
